title: Axion Misalignment Across First-Order Phase Transitions

split.decision: Secret random grouped split of all 28 original (H*,v_w) slices: ceil(20%)=6 hidden test slices, then ceil(20% of remaining)=5 public validation slices; 17 training slices. Row counts 396/330/1122. Seed and original-row mapping are operator-only in judge/split_manifest.json.

baseline.paper_ref: Sec. IV D / Eq.25 / Fig.7. Historical full-table released-fit reproduction: 0.11025001155862336; not a held-out reference. Newly reconstructed train-only Powell fitting protocol.

allowed_changes: Fitting solver, initialization, training objective, numerical approximation during fitting and enhancement expression predictor within physical/capacity requirements.
Train-only fitting of up to seven global constants, certified via editable scalar expressions over fixed physical primitives.
When retaining the supplied Powell fitting routine, changing only maxfev=4000 (PHY13_FIT_MAXFEV), maxiter=1000, xtol=1e-4 or ftol=1e-7 does not count as a method improvement.
Changing only the `INITIAL` or `BOUNDS` constants in `baseline.py` also does not count.
fixed_contract: Reduce natural-log RMSE of original lattice enhancement xi on held-out physical slices with at most seven globally fitted enhancement constants.
Original lattice enhancement xi, physical inputs and materialized held-out (H*,v_w) slice protocol.
At most seven globally data-fitted enhancement constants; fixed independent pilot-kappa, geometry, Fanh/Finf and Minkowski calibration are not extra fitting channels.
Natural-log RMSE and all four original physical smoke checks.
